content: Photos are represented using convolutional neural net (CNN) models pretrained on ImageNet BIBREF17. We use a MobileNet model with a depth multiplier of 1.4, and an input dimension of $224 \times 224$ pixels as in BIBREF18. This provides a $1,280 \times 1.4 = 1,792$-dimensional representation of a photo, which is then passed through a single hidden layer of dimensionality $1,024$ with ReLU activation, before being passed to a hidden layer of dimensionality 512 with no activation to provide the final representation $h_p$.
